name: Mixel Partial-Volume Rendering
definition: A partial-volume rendering technique that uses real stored mixel fractions at tissue boundaries instead of synthetic blur-derived ones. It blends the voxel's own rendered signal with the second tissue's slice-mean signal based on the mixel fraction.
summary: Mixel Partial-Volume Rendering blends signals using real stored mixel fractions at tissue boundaries, preserving texture detail better than synthetic blur methods.
